reviews.comment: She obv. cares but the lectures were not good and the homework was not conducive to becoming proficient in the material. The tests are 95% of the grade and easy, just a copy of practice tests, so an easy A if you do those. Don't think I really learned besides plug and chug formulas from the slides despite getting an A and going to officehours alot.

Very caring professor, but lectures were very unengaging. I often had to learn the material outside of class. The practice exams and quizzes were helpful but I felt as if the actual exams were more difficult. If can do the HW and practices easily, you should be good when it comes to exams.

I agree with other students that lectures are unengaging. However, I think the practice exams, quizzes, homework, and in-class examples are good study material for exams. It was doable for me to go through all of that while making sure I understood it. She is helpful during office hours. I also read the textbook for the initial chapters.

She is very sweet, but if she tells you that she can see you passing, don't believe her. Her grading is extremely inconsistent. She literally miscounted how many points someone got on the exam. Exams are similar to the quizzes and homework. She is not a very good lecturer but she is accessible all the time and will sit with you and explain stuff.

Professor Balbuena is not a good lecturer, she is difficult to understand and doesn't explain concepts clearly. She's very nice and will work with you if you have questions but I found myself using the textbook most often. Her exams are fair and based off of the practice exams that are given. Class is definitely doable just not the most optimal.

She needs to retire. She cannot teach and attending her lectures is pointless. She doesn't know how to grade. I got a question right and she marked it completely wrong and then said I guess I'll fix it?? I got the vibes that she had favorites in the class as well (so sit in the front). Exams are impossible because her grading is all over the place.

Most of the grade is based on the midterm exams and the final.  The exam problems are very similar to the homework and the example problems in the slides.  The professor goes over the slides and the examples specifically in pretty good detail so there wasn't a ton of confusion when learning how to do the problems associated with the material.

Thermo 2 is definitely a step up from other Chen classes before this point. Balbuena is not necessarily the Prof you want to have for this difficulty spike but she's fine if you read the textbook. Lectures can be confusing a times. Rule of thumb study so you understand those and if you can you'll be golden. Exam difficulty varies.

Dr. Balbuena is such a nice lady; however, her lectures are super ambiguous and often leave you more confused than when you entered. Her exams are very difficult, closed notes and free response. But, she does give practice exams, and if you do those and understand them, you can do good on the exams.

Difficult to understand her. Doesn't understand student questions or respond to emails. No partial credit on difficult exams. Do not attend lectures, she reads off the slide. Very unorganized. Curves at end but most of semester half of the class has failing grade. Do not take, will be too stressful and luck based on which questions she chooses

She is a nice person but can't teach for the anything. The lectures and super useless and you are better off just teaching yourself. That being said if you do the homework's and practice exams you will do fine in her class just don't expect to learn anything from her.

Dr. Balbuena is a sweet lady but struggles to lecture. Her lectures are all over the place which makes it hard to understand the problems. However, if you do all the example problems from her lecture slides and understand the homework's, you will make good grades on her exams which are usually similar to those problems or her practice exams.

Lectures are basically useless. The easiest way to get the homework done and study for the tests is to read the textbook closely and pay attention to any previous exams she gives out. The homework isn't usually too bad compared to the rest of CHEN junior year classes, and you get a partner. Exams are hard.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: CHEN 354 during Fall Semester. Prof Balbuena annotates PowerPoints for lecture. Would recommend to read the textbook. Exams are open textbook, Excel sheet, and/or Matlab file. Would recommend you load your Excel sheet and understand all topics covered in the chapters. Show some work on exams to get good partial credit. Will save you in the end!
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Thermo 2 is a hard class. The best piece of advice is to just accept that you will have to read the textbook. Her lectures were kinda and all over the place as she would talk and incorporate things from future chapters into chapters in which those concepts have not been introduced. Read the textbook and you will understand the class a lot better.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: She's alright as a professor. Lectures were slow and sometimes hard to follow, but she basically follows the textbook. You can usually guess what will be on the tests by looking at the material, but she doesn't give much partial credit on tests. She curves well, but you never fully know where you stand grade-wise as you go through the semester.

Not the worst prof you can take for thermo, but lectures are a little slow. Skip lecture (to do hw or something) and then watch in 2x speed and you'll be golden. Don't wait for the last min on the semester project - harder than it seems. HW done in group, blessing or a curse. Tests not horrible, she curves well too.

Not super helpful outside of class, and sometimes she asked questions she does not know the answers which were not helpful during lecture(she just says yeah). Emailed her few times, she seemed like she did not care and respond slow. No explanation on exams either. Don't take her if you have another choice!
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This was the hardest class I've taken so far, I had to take this class during COVID but I don't think it had anything to do with how horrible the class was. the tests were insanely hard and no partial credit was given. I had to hire a tutor and still made 70s on the tests they were so hard. DONT TAKE VERY FRUSTRATING.

I really Like Dr. Balbuena because she is super nice patient and shows us what exactly we did wrong on the homework making the exam easier to study for. Her exams are definitely reasonable, its a hard subject don' expect it to be easy. but with Balbuena, it def is an enjoyable class and if I have an opportunity to take her for another class I will.
